what_changed: Reuters: Congo banned copper and cobalt concentrate exports, a new supply shock supporting the FCX long. Barrick settled the Nevada JV dispute with Newmont for $1.95B, clearing the way for an IPO; opened a NEM long. Crude rebounded (WTI 78, headlines cite above 82) on Hormuz deal doubts; LLY +3.2% over 5 days after its guidance raise.

chips.why: TSMC sales +45% confirms AI demand but NVDA +11.6% in 5 days already prices it; earnings late August are two-sided.
